notes: Already-consented bundles now show a green 'Consent granted' pill instead of the Grant admin consent button. The backend probes each customer tenant by asking Microsoft for a client_credentials token for the bundle's app — if Microsoft hands back a token, the service principal exists in the customer tenant and consent has been granted. 60-second in-memory cache so the tenant page doesn't hammer the OAuth endpoint
Bundle labels now render as 'Conditional Access - Pro' (drop 'Vault', tier separated by ' - '). 'CAV X' was ambiguous and didn't match the Conditional Access tab name. Internal storage keys unchanged
